name: Do tankless water heaters make rumbling noises?

mainEntity.name: Do tankless water heaters make rumbling noises?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, tankless water heaters do not typically make the same rumbling noises as traditional tank-style units. Rumbling in conventional heaters is caused by sediment boiling at the bottom of the tank. Tankless heaters heat water on demand as it flows through a heat exchanger, so there's no standing water or sediment accumulation within a large tank. If a tankless unit makes unusual noises, it could indicate other issues like mineral buildup in the heat exchanger or a problem with the burner, requiring professional inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tankless water heaters do not make rumbling noises because they lack a tank where sediment can accumulate. Unusual noises in a tankless unit indicate a different issue.
